translation.name: Seongsu Local Food & Dessert Walk
translation.summary: A food-focused Seongsu route mixing specialty coffee, a hearty Korean meal, local-style dessert and a final cafe stop.
translation.description: Seongsu is famous for trend-led cafes, but it also has long-running local food and newer Korean comfort-food spots. This route mixes both sides. It is intentionally paced with walking and browsing time between stops, so travelers do not need to order a full meal at every location.

stops.note: Start with specialty coffee rather than a heavy meal.
Make this the main meal stop. Busy meal periods may mean a wait.
Pick up a takeout dessert; there is no need to plan a long stop.
Use the cafe and select-shop format as a longer rest stop.
End with an unstructured walk so you can add a spontaneous snack or pop-up.
